brand.name: Afterglow
brand.tagline: One fragrance told in four stages, from the gold of last light to deep violet, and you do not see the bottle until the end.
brand.product: A signature fragrance. One scent, not a range.
brand.character: The hour after sunset. A thing met in sequence, not all at once.
brand.visual-world: Four stages tracing the sky after sundown. The light only ever deepens. The brand is felt in the world, never stamped on it.
brand.reveal-rule: The bottle is shown last. Nothing in the storefront leads with packaging.
brand.launch-fiction: Launch night 17 October 2026, Brooklyn venue, doors 7:00 PM. Press walk through the scent room by room before seeing the bottle.

ground.name: Void
ground.use: Page ground. Required by the deepening-light rule, not borrowed

stages._note: Week 2. Four stages, each darker and warmer than the last. Define with Shopify's color_palette setting type, which replaced colour schemes in June 2026.

2._note: Unnamed in the source material. Sits between gold and rose.

typography._status: Week 2. Set the scale measured, not eyeballed.

shadow._status: Week 2. On a void ground, elevation reads through surface steps more than shadow.

motion._status: Week 2 for values. Personality is locked.
motion.personality: Deepening, never snapping. The scent is met as a journey, not a cloud.
